articles.title: Caught on Camera, Shot While Arrest: Moradabad Molestation Accused Naushad Nabbed After Encounter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moradabad Police have arrested Naushad, the accused in a molestation case involving a burqa-clad woman, after he sustained a bullet injury in the leg during police action.

body.html:
Moradabad Police have arrested Naushad, the accused in a molestation case involving a burqa-clad woman, after he sustained a bullet injury in the leg during police action.

The incident took place in the Barbalan area under Mughalpura police station limits, where a woman was allegedly harassed in broad daylight. According to the complaint, the victim was walking to work when the accused began following her. After trailing her for some distance, he approached from behind, grabbed her, and made obscene gestures.

The woman immediately raised an alarm and protested, prompting the accused to flee. CCTV footage of the incident clearly captured the accuse, who was seen wearing a skullcap, aiding in his identification.

Based on the victim’s complaint, an FIR was registered on Thursday (30 April 2026). The case triggered public outrage, with locals raising serious concerns over women’s safety.

Superintendent of Police (City) Kumar Ranvijay Singh stated that the accused was identified through CCTV footage, following which multiple police teams were deployed to track him down. During the operation, Naushad was apprehended after sustaining a leg injury, and has since been taken into custody.

Police said continuous raids were conducted before the arrest, and further legal action is underway.

#Moradabad #UPPolice #MolestationCase #BreakingNews #WomenSafety

articles.title: Varmala Drama in MP: Bride Dumps Groom Mid-Ceremony, Garlands Lover as Wedding Turns Chaotic
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident unfolded in Madhya Pradesh’s Chhindwara district when a bride ran off the stage during the varmala ceremony and chose her lover over the groom, triggering chaos at the wedding venue. The incident took place in Umreth on the intervening night of April 27-28.

body.html:
A dramatic incident unfolded in Madhya Pradesh’s Chhindwara district when a bride ran off the stage during the varmala ceremony and chose her lover over the groom, triggering chaos at the wedding venue.

The incident took place in Umreth on the intervening night of April 27-28. The groom, from the Bhalavi family, had arrived from Parasia to Mujawar village with his wedding procession. The baraat was welcomed with celebrations, and preparations for the varmala ceremony were underway.

According to reports, the groom had reached the stage and the bride soon joined him with the garland in her hand. However, moments later, she looked around and suddenly ran off the stage. She approached her lover, who was present in the pandal, embraced him, and placed the varmala around his neck.

The unexpected act shocked everyone present at the venue. The bride’s family allegedly assaulted the youth, leading to a scuffle between both sides. The situation escalated as tensions rose between the groom’s party and the bride’s family.

Following the incident, the groom refused to proceed with the marriage, and the baraat returned without the wedding taking place.

Reports suggest the bride had been in a relationship with her lover for the past two years, and her family was aware of it. However, under family pressure, she had agreed to the marriage. Seeing her partner at the venue reportedly led her to change her decision.

After the incident, the bride remained at her home, while her family reportedly took back jewellery, ring, and mobile phone. The groom’s side has alleged loss of social and financial prestige and has filed a complaint at the police station.

Police have initiated an investigation into the matter, and further action is underway.

#Chhindwara #WeddingDrama #ViralVideo #BreakingNews #LoveAffair

articles.title: Birthday Visit Turns Deadly: Wife, Father-in-Law Arrested 4 Months After Poison Murder in Agra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The mystery surrounding the death of a young man in the Trans Yamuna area of Agra has been solved after four months, with police arresting his wife and father-in-law for allegedly poisoning him.

body.html:
The mystery surrounding the death of a young man in the Trans Yamuna area of Agra has been solved after four months, with police arresting his wife and father-in-law for allegedly poisoning him.

According to ACP Chhatta Sheshmani Upadhyay, the deceased, Yatendra Pal, a factory worker and resident of Trans Yamuna, had married Tanu, a resident of Foundry Nagar, three years ago. The couple had ongoing disputes, due to which Tanu was living at her parental home.

On November 22, 2025, Yatendra visited his in-laws’ house to mark his wife’s birthday. In the early hours around 3:00 am, his condition suddenly deteriorated, and he was rushed to a hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

Initially, the cause of death remained unclear. During the post-mortem, viscera samples were preserved for examination. The deceased’s mother, Manju, raised suspicions, claiming her son had previously been taken to the hospital under unclear circumstances. When police allegedly did not act on the complaint, the family approached the court.

Following court intervention, an FIR was registered at Trans Yamuna Police Station on January 5. The investigation was later transferred to Kamla Nagar Police Station on March 16.

The breakthrough came after the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) report confirmed that Yatendra died due to Sulphas poisoning. During investigation, police found that a dispute had occurred on the night of the incident, after which the father-in-law, Mahendra, allegedly procured Sulphas, mixed it in alcohol, and gave it to Yatendra.

His condition worsened after consuming the drink, leading to his death.

Police have arrested the accused—wife Tanu and her father Mahendra—and produced them before the court, from where they were sent to judicial custody. Further investigation in the case is ongoing.

#Agra #MurderMystery #PoisoningCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Dinner Dispute Turns Deadly: Woman Allegedly Kills Husband Over Non-Veg Row in Telangana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman allegedly killed her husband following a late-night argument over non-vegetarian food and ongoing domestic tensions in Telangana’s Kamareddy district.

body.html:
A woman allegedly killed her husband following a late-night argument over non-vegetarian food and ongoing domestic tensions in Telangana’s Kamareddy district.

The incident occurred on April 2 at a rented house where the couple, Kodanda Shivaji and Lakshmi, lived with their two daughters aged two and one.

According to police, the family had been under financial stress for several months, with frequent disputes over money, food, and lifestyle. On the night of the incident, the argument reportedly began when Shivaji questioned Lakshmi for not preparing non-vegetarian food.

What started as a verbal altercation soon escalated. In a fit of rage, Lakshmi allegedly picked up a machete kept in the house and attacked Shivaji, striking him on the neck. He collapsed and died on the spot due to heavy bleeding.

Neighbours, alerted by loud arguments and cries, informed the police. Officials reached the spot, secured the scene, and shifted the body for post-mortem examination.

Police Circle Inspector Narahari said preliminary investigation indicates repeated domestic disputes stemming from financial and personal issues. “On the day of the incident, a minor argument escalated into a violent act. The accused has been taken into custody,” he said.

A murder case has been registered, and further investigation is underway. Police are also examining whether the act was committed under sudden provocation or involved prior intent.

#Telangana #Kamareddy #CrimeNews #DomesticViolence #BreakingNews

articles.title: Daring Daylight Heist in Gorakhpur: Teen Girl Takes on Robbers, Injured but Accused Flee
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Gorakhpur on Monday afternoon, a jewellery shop in Ward No. 17 of the Gola suburb was targeted in a daylight robbery. Two young men entered Devansh Swarnkala Kendra posing as customers and, seizing an opportunity, snatched around 20 grams of gold before fleeing.

body.html:
In Gorakhpur on Monday afternoon, a jewellery shop in Ward No. 17 of the Gola suburb was targeted in a daylight robbery. Two young men entered Devansh Swarnkala Kendra posing as customers and, seizing an opportunity, snatched around 20 grams of gold before fleeing.

The shop owner’s 18-year-old daughter, Amrita, who was managing the store in her father Rakesh Verma’s absence, showed remarkable courage. She raised an alarm and chased the accused for nearly 100 metres. During the chase, she managed to grab one of the suspects and pulled him down, leading to a scuffle. However, the accused pushed her, causing injury to her hand, and escaped with his accomplice.

According to Amrita, the incident took place around 2:20 pm when the two youths asked to see jewellery. One of them grabbed 4-5 pairs of earrings weighing about 20 grams and ran out of the shop.

The stolen gold is estimated to be worth approximately ₹2.5 lakh, as stated by shop owner Rakesh Verma, who had stepped out to distribute engagement cards for his elder daughter.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, showing the accused fleeing through a lane while Amrita chased them. She is seen catching one suspect and bringing him to the ground before he breaks free and escapes. The second accused was reportedly waiting nearby with a motorcycle near Sarya Vegetable Market, and both fled the scene together.

Dr Anil Tiwari, whose clinic is located opposite the shop, confirmed that Amrita sustained a minor hand injury and was treated before being sent home.

Station In-charge Rakesh Roshan Singh stated that police reached the spot promptly after receiving information and have launched an investigation. Efforts are underway to identify and arrest the accused using CCTV footage.

#Gorakhpur #DaylightRobbery #CrimeNews #CCTVFootage #BraveGirl

articles.title: Proof of Death or No Money? Odisha Man Digs Up Sister’s Skeleton, Walks Into Bank
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Odisha’s Keonjhar district, a tribal man allegedly brought the skeletal remains of his deceased sister to a bank in an attempt to withdraw money from her account, police said on Monday.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Odisha’s Keonjhar district, a tribal man allegedly brought the skeletal remains of his deceased sister to a bank in an attempt to withdraw money from her account, police said on Monday.

The incident took place at the Maliposi branch of Odisha Grameen Bank in Patana block. The man, identified as Jeetu Munda (50), a resident of Dianali village, was trying to withdraw Rs 20,000 deposited in the account of his elder sister, Kalra Munda (56), who died two months ago after an illness. The amount was reportedly earned through the sale of her cattle.

According to officials, Jeetu Munda had approached the bank earlier but was asked to produce a death certificate and other necessary documents. Unable to furnish the required paperwork, he allegedly exhumed his sister’s skeletal remains from her burial site and brought them to the bank as proof of her death.

Speaking to reporters, Jeetu Munda claimed that despite informing bank officials about his sister’s death, he was repeatedly asked to bring the account holder in person. “Out of frustration, I dug the grave and brought her skeleton to show that she is no more,” he said.

Patana Police Station Inspector-in-Charge Kiran Prasad Sahu, who reached the spot after being alerted, said that Jeetu Munda, being illiterate, was unaware of the legal procedures regarding withdrawal from a deceased person’s account. He added that the bank officials failed to adequately explain the process to him.

Following the incident, the police assured assistance in facilitating the withdrawal process. The skeletal remains were later reburied in the presence of the police.

Local Block Development Officer Manas Dandpat stated that he had not been approached earlier regarding the issue and assured that necessary steps would be taken to resolve the matter.

Bank sources revealed that the nominee listed in Kalra Munda’s account had also passed away, making Jeetu Munda the sole claimant. The local administration has now directed bank officials to ensure that the funds are released to him as per the rules at the earliest.

The incident has sparked outrage and raised serious questions about procedural awareness, accessibility, and the handling of vulnerable individuals within the banking system.

#Odisha #Keonjhar #BankingSystem #Bureaucracy #GroundReality

articles.title: No Ambulance, No Choice? Agra Family Forced to Carry Patient on Bike With IV Drip
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video has surfaced from the Teedi Bagiya area of Agra, showing three people travelling on a motorcycle under distressing circumstances. In the footage, a young man is seen riding the bike, while a patient sits behind him.

body.html:
A shocking video has surfaced from the Teedi Bagiya area of Agra, showing three people travelling on a motorcycle under distressing circumstances. In the footage, a young man is seen riding the bike, while a patient sits behind him. A woman accompanying them is holding an IV drip, highlighting the critical condition of the patient.

According to reports, the patient’s health was deteriorating rapidly and required immediate medical transportation. However, an ambulance or any other emergency facility was allegedly not available in time, forcing the family to resort to this risky measure. Locals claim that the family opted for the motorcycle after failing to secure a government ambulance.

The incident, recorded by a passerby, has now gone viral on social media, drawing widespread attention. Reactions have been mixed, with some describing it as an act of helplessness, while others have raised concerns over possible lapses in the healthcare system.

The video has triggered serious questions about emergency response services. Are ambulances not reaching patients on time during critical situations? Are families being forced to risk lives due to lack of access to basic healthcare infrastructure? The incident has now become a subject of public debate, putting the functioning of the concerned authorities under scrutiny.

articles.title: Chilling Murder in Surat: Wife Strangled, Body Hidden in Cement-Filled Box by Husband
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Surat (Gujarat): In a shocking case, a man allegedly strangled his wife and concealed her body inside a cement-filled wooden box at his residence in Surat’s Salabatpura area, police said. The accused, Vishal, and the deceased, Shilpa, had been married since 2010.

body.html:
Surat (Gujarat): In a shocking case, a man allegedly strangled his wife and concealed her body inside a cement-filled wooden box at his residence in Surat’s Salabatpura area, police said.

The accused, Vishal, and the deceased, Shilpa, had been married since 2010. According to police, Vishal had been unemployed for the past couple of years after working in the diamond industry, leading to frequent disputes between the couple. Shilpa was reportedly managing the household alone.

Shilpa’s father, Kosta, a resident of Chhattisgarh, told police that he had travelled to Surat multiple times to mediate between the couple due to their ongoing conflicts. On April 21, when he tried calling his daughter, her phone was switched off. Vishal allegedly told him that she had not returned from the hospital, raising suspicion.

Sensing something was wrong, Kosta rushed to Surat and questioned Vishal, who reportedly gave evasive answers. Around the same time, the accused attempted to flee after leaving behind a confession note on a relative’s phone but was later detained by police.

According to investigators, the confession letter led police to Vishal’s house, where they discovered Shilpa’s body concealed inside a 4.5 square-foot wooden box filled with mud and cement.

Police said Vishal confessed in the note that he suspected his wife’s character. On April 20, he allegedly took her to his ancestral home on a motorcycle, strangled her, and then hid the body.

Inspector R.A. Jadeja confirmed that the body was recovered in a concealed condition and that further investigation is underway.

The incident has sent shockwaves in the area, highlighting yet another case of domestic violence turning fatal.

#Surat #Gujarat #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Mystery Deaths in Mumbai: Family of Four Dies After Late-Night Meal, Food Poisoning Suspected
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai (Maharashtra): In a tragic and mysterious incident, four members of a family, including two minor girls, died due to suspected food poisoning in the Pydhonie area, police said.

body.html:
Mumbai (Maharashtra): In a tragic and mysterious incident, four members of a family, including two minor girls, died due to suspected food poisoning in the Pydhonie area, police said.

The deceased have been identified as Abdullah Dokadia (40), his wife Nasreen (35), and their daughters Aisha (16) and Zainab (13).

According to police, the incident began on the night of April 25, when nine family members had dinner together around 10:30 pm. After the meal, relatives left for their homes, while the four victims reportedly consumed watermelon between 1:00 am and 1:30 am.

By early morning on April 26, around 5:30 am to 6:00 am, all four developed severe symptoms, including vomiting and diarrhoea. They were first treated by a family doctor and later shifted to JJ Hospital.

Despite treatment, the younger daughter died around 10:15 am, followed by the father at approximately 10:30 pm. The mother and elder daughter also succumbed during treatment.

Police have registered an Accidental Death (AD) case at JJ Marg Police Station. Post-mortem examinations have been conducted, and the exact cause of death will be confirmed after histopathological reports.

Preliminary inputs suggest the family had consumed biryani before eating watermelon, but officials stated that the exact source of contamination remains unclear and is under investigation.

In a separate incident in Jharkhand’s Giridih district, a seven-year-old child died and 18 others fell ill after allegedly consuming contaminated street food, prompting a health probe.

Authorities have urged the public to maintain food hygiene and remain cautious, as investigations continue into both cases.

#Mumbai #FoodPoisoning #BreakingNews #PublicHealth #IndiaNews

articles.title: Daylight Daring Robbery in Firozabad: ₹10 Lakh Looted at Gunpoint, Girl Among Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Firozabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a brazen daylight robbery, three bike-borne criminals allegedly looted ₹10 lakh at gunpoint from a seed merchant’s employee in the Sirsaganj police station area.

body.html:
Firozabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a brazen daylight robbery, three bike-borne criminals allegedly looted ₹10 lakh at gunpoint from a seed merchant’s employee in the Sirsaganj police station area.

The incident took place on Monday morning in Adhyapak Nagar when the victim, Bunty Kumar, son of Aidal Singh, was on his way to deposit cash at a Bank of Baroda branch. According to the complaint, the accused intercepted him on the way and threatened him with a pistol.

The assailants, who were reportedly on a motorcycle and accompanied by a girl, snatched the bag containing ₹10 lakh and fled the scene. The incident has created panic among local traders.

Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and launched a cordon-and-search operation. CCTV footage from the surrounding area is being examined to identify the accused.

Circle Officer Anivesh Kumar Singh said that multiple police teams have been formed to crack the case, and investigation is underway from all angles.

Authorities have assured that the accused will be arrested soon.

#Firozabad #UttarPradesh #Robbery #BreakingNews #CrimeNews
